device_label: 1 mm SOH MZM, optically packaged, 56 GBd PAM4 linear drive at 265 mVpp

modulation_format: PAM4 Gray-coded, PRBS 2^11-1; without RF amplifier 24, 48, 54 and 56 GBd at 299, 253, 252 and 265 mVpp; with 11 dB RF amplifier 48 and 56 GBd swept at fixed 0.6 dBm received power, optimum Ud,pp/Upi about 0.45
driver: MultiLane ML4039E BERT with CMOS SerDes (up to 56 GBd PAM4) and balun, no RF amplifier in the headline experiment (optional SHF 827 amplifier, 11 dB gain, in the second experiment); 50 ohm termination; PD plus TIA receiver module into the Rx SerDes; no optical amplifier
notes: Single device (one of an array of eight MZMs on the die; the O-band 0.5 mm device with 0.46 V mm and 0.92 V is from an earlier paper and not entered). Vpi 1 V stated for the 1 mm device after poling, measurement frequency not stated; push-pull from the opposite field directions in the two slots (p.7). Wavelength: carrier around 1550 nm (p.8 text) and 1550 nm (Fig. 4 caption); imbalanced MZM set to quadrature by the carrier wavelength. UpiL 1.0 V mm reported, stored as 0.1 V cm. IL: 10.8 dB fiber-to-fiber and 4.2 dB on-chip excess loss stated by the authors (p.6, p.8); it equals the Table 2 sum of the on-chip elements (cutback test structures) and 10.8 dB minus two estimated 3.3 dB photonic wire bonds (p.16). Slot-waveguide loss 2.8 dB/mm from cutback on un-poled material, stored as 28 dB/cm. No bandwidth, extinction ratio, Z0, n_RF, RF loss or energy reported. Fiber power swept 8.0 to 16.3 dBm, 0.2 to 8.5 dBm at each on-chip phase shifter (not entered, sweep). Swing 265 mVpp is the balun output at 56 GBd. BER below the KP4 limit (2.4e-4) is stated for 54 GBd above -1.3 dBm received power (Fig. 4 caption); the introduction states it for 112 Gbit/s; 56 GBd points in Fig. 4(b) lie near the KP4 line. Not reported: temperature, electrode metal, electrode gap, device dimensions of the GSG line.
